draft.rationale: Schema field descriptions drafted in accordance with broadcast pilot aggregate report semantics and constraints.
risks: Gross/Net convention disputes require human applicability review.
Payment terms must not be used to calculate raw due_date.

descriptions.invoice_number: Explicitly labelled invoice or bill identifier, excluding contract, order, or contact IDs.
descriptions.total_gross: Explicitly printed gross total amount, following printed labels without arithmetic invention.
descriptions.total_net: Explicitly printed net total amount, following printed labels without arithmetic invention.
descriptions.total_vat: Explicitly printed tax or VAT amount, following printed labels without arithmetic invention.
descriptions.amount_due: Explicitly printed total amount due, following printed labels without arithmetic invention.
descriptions.seller_vat_id: Value Added Tax identifier of the seller only, excluding EIN, FCC ID, or station callsign.
descriptions.seller_name: Name of the paid media seller or broadcast station.
descriptions.buyer_name: Explicitly billed advertiser or advertising agency.
descriptions.due_date: Explicit printed due date; must not be calculated or inferred from payment terms.

authority: advisory only; Python validation and human signature required
